tools.name: apitemplate_get_account
tools.description: The APITemplate.io account behind this key: plan, subscription status and period, and the quota: api_quota, api_used, api_remaining (generations), plus the template quota and count. Check api_remaining before generating. GET /v2/account-information.

tools.name: apitemplate_list_templates
tools.description: List the templates of the account (PDF and image): template_id, name, format (PDF or JPEG), status, group and dates. Use the template_id with the create tools. Read-only; templates are never changed. GET /v2/list-templates.

tools.name: apitemplate_get_template
tools.description: One PDF template's HTML body, CSS and print settings (the vendor marks this endpoint experimental, so it can answer with an error for some accounts or image templates). Read-only. GET /v2/get-template.

tools.name: apitemplate_list_objects
tools.description: List the PDFs and images generated so far, newest first: transaction_ref, template_id, type (PDF, JPEG or MERGE), your meta reference, the hosted file URLs (primary_url, secondary_url for the PNG) and dates. Files already deleted or expired have deletion_status set. Read-only. GET /v2/list-objects.

tools.name: apitemplate_create_pdf
tools.description: WRITE: renders one PDF from a saved PDF template and your JSON data (the keys the template uses, e.g. invoice_number, items), and returns the hosted download_url (never the file bytes). COST: uses 1 generation of your APITemplate.io plan quota per call (see apitemplate_get_account). Do not retry or repeat it

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: apitemplate_get_template, apitemplate_list_objects · Private data: apitemplate_list_objects, apitemplate_create_pdf, apitemplate_create_image, apitemplate_create_pdf_from_html, apitemplate_create_pdf_from_markdown, apitemplate_create_pdf_from_url, apitemplate_merge_pdfs · Public sink: apitemplate_create_pdf, apitemplate_create_image, apitemplate_create_pdf_from_html, apitemplate_create_pdf_from_markdown, apitemplate_create_pdf_from_url, apitemplate_merge_pdfs · Destructive: apitemplate_list_templates.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: apitemplate_get_template, apitemplate_list_objects · Private data: apitemplate_list_objects, apitemplate_create_pdf, apitemplate_create_image, apitemplate_create_pdf_from_html, apitemplate_create_pdf_from_markdown, apitemplate_create_pdf_from_url, apitemplate_merge_pdfs · Public sink: apitemplate_create_pdf, apitemplate_create_image, apitemplate_create_pdf_from_html, apitemplate_create_pdf_from_markdown, apitemplate_create_pdf_from_url, apitemplate_merge_pdfs · Destructive: apitemplate_list_templates

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
